title: Grateful Dead Live at Onongada County War Memorial on 1982-04-08
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) -> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) ->Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC
source: (2) Beyer M160's + (1) Sennheiser 421 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M)

ai_review.summary: High‑resolution 24‑bit recording captures a sweet‑sounding 1982 set, but the performance is described as energetic yet sloppy.
ai_review.review: Listeners praise the crystal‑clear 24‑bit sound and the sweet tonal quality of this 1982 recording, giving it high marks for audio fidelity. However, the show itself receives mixed feedback, with some describing it as energetic but loosely executed and Garcia’s playing unfocused. Overall the tape sounds great, but the musical performance is seen as uneven.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive comments on recording quality (24‑bit, sweet sound) raise the technical score, while only one review notes a sloppy performance, lowering the show rating; weighted average yields ~3.2.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Praised for 24‑bit depth and sweet, clear sound; no reported dropouts or muddiness.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia described as 'all over the place' and sloppy.
